installCommand: dnf install -y -q php8.3-cli php8.3-mbstring php8.3-xml php8.3-pdo php8.3-pgsql php8.3-zip php8.3-gd php8.3-intl php8.3-bcmath php8.3-opcache && curl -sS https://getcomposer.org/installer | php -- --quiet --install-dir=/usr/local/bin --filename=composer && composer install --no-dev --prefer-dist --no-interaction --no-progress --optimize-autoloader && npm ci
